initialization: All models start from the same saved 200000 model; fresh optimizer, resume=false.
camera0: Overhead: geometry only for crop/shift/combined; appearance according to profile.
camera1: Wrist: never apply geometry. Noise only in combined; appearance according to profile.
baseline: Evaluate original 200000 checkpoint; no matched extra-100000 no-augmentation training control.
limits: Offline in-domain stress tests are not unseen-environment or real-robot success rates.
